class.name: SteamCheatReportPage
class.brief_description: A bounded read-only page of Valve reports in increasing report ID order.
class.description: Reports are ordered by the full unsigned Valve report ID. Use [member next_report_id] as [param after_report_id] in another [method SteamPublisherModeration.reports] call with the same UTC window. The cursor is present when the current reply contained rows beyond the local 64-report page limit.

method.name: get_reports
method.description: Returns the detached reports for this page.

method.name: get_next_report_id
method.description: Returns the exclusive continuation cursor, or empty when no additional row is known.

members.member: The detached reports for this page.
The exclusive continuation cursor, or empty when no additional row is known.
